description: Set within the Sunset District just steps from Ocean Beach, 2628 Yorba Street pairs an easy, move-in-ready interior with something increasingly rare in San Francisco — room to grow. This charming wood-framed home offers comfortable living space, 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, a massive 2-car garage with amazing ceiling height, and a huge, blank-canvas backyard and garden with herbs, marigolds, salvia for butterflies, humming birds, for peaceful enjoyment or the perfect bbq.
